exposure: Intermediate hyperglycemia (fasting plasma glucose 5.1-6.9 mM) in the first half of pregnancy
cohort: 42,406 pregnant women at the Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital, Shanghai, China, between 2013 and 2017
finding: An early OGTT in women with intermediate hyperglycemia at the first prenatal visit was not significantly associated with an altered risk of LGA but was associated with an increased odds of neonatal hyperbilirubinemia.
